summary: TEST 8 (mobile/touch cross-category MOVE contract) executed as a READ-ONLY audit against SortableTilesProvider.jsx L146/L224 and NotesApp.jsx handleCrossPackMove L1886-1946. Real touch drag dispatched via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent (touchStart @ t1 grip, +8/+8 activation, 30-step trajectory to t4 center, final touchMove @ target, touchEnd) at 390x844. Final pointer clearly INSIDE Errands pack rect so Repair #5 boundary check does NOT short-circuit; the drop DID reach onCrossPackMove. Result: TEST 8 FAILS the MOVE contract — behavior is COPY exactly as the source code prescribes when the modifier key is absent (touch cannot hold ⌘/Ctrl). Passive desktop mouse-drag without Cmd/Ctrl on 1400x1000 also produced COPY (as intentionally designed). No source, config, CSS, or architecture changes were made.

action_items: DO NOT AUTO-FIX (per review_request explicit instruction). This is the P2 deferred backlog item flagged in iter_85/86/87 audits: touch cross-category drops default to COPY because dnd-kit's TouchSensor cannot carry a modifier key. If the product now wants touch = MOVE, the one-line change is at SortableTilesProvider.jsx L224 — dispatch 'move' when input is touch (e.g., detect from event.activatorEvent instanceof TouchEvent or pointerType==='touch') OR expose a settings toggle 'Touch drag: move vs copy'. Requires product decision because it flips the current documented touch behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: SortableTilesProvider.jsx L224: `onCrossPackMove?.(sourcePackId, targetPackId, activeId, modifier ? 'move' : 'copy')` — touch has no modifier surface, so touch cross-pack is ALWAYS copy. This is by design per prior audits but conflicts with iOS-style user expectations where drag = move.

NotesApp.jsx L1915-1929: copy branch keeps source note's `pack_id`, `pack_name`, `pack_accent` and overrides only category/category_path/id/timestamps/order. Copy semantics themselves are internally consistent (fresh uuidv4, correct destination category_path, resets subcategory to ''). No bug in the copy path itself.
handleCrossPackMove undo action for copy branch calls StorageService.deleteNote(copy.id) — correct symmetric undo. Good.
No console errors, no toast leak, no orphaned drag state after the drop — Repair #5 tracker attach/detach lifecycle behaved correctly during this test as well.

context_for_next_testing_agent: TEST 8 is a specification/behavior mismatch, NOT a regression. Iteration 87's Repair #5 is still holding (V1 wobble scenario still bails out correctly — that path was NOT re-exercised here but the containment predicate was observed to behave correctly against the LEGIT cross-pack drop in this test, i.e. it correctly identified the pointer as OUTSIDE source and DID dispatch to onCrossPackMove). The only outstanding decision is product: touch=copy (current) vs touch=move (user's TEST 8 assertion). Do not attempt to 'fix' TEST 8 until a product owner confirms the desired touch default.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: SortableTilesProvider.jsx L146 sets `modifier = orig.metaKey || orig.ctrlKey` at drag-start. On touch, activatorEvent is a TouchEvent which has no metaKey/ctrlKey (both undefined), so `modifier` is false. handleDragEnd L224 then unconditionally dispatches mode='copy'. handleCrossPackMove in NotesApp.jsx L1915-1929 mints a fresh uuidv4 clone. Therefore every genuine touch cross-category drop is COPY by construction.
reproduction_steps: 1. Seed IDB with 5 notes across two categories in the same pack (see seed_data_creation).
2. Load app at 390x844, switch to icon (grid) view with group_by_category=true.
3. CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent: touchStart @ note-tile-grip-t1 center (38,755), touchMove +8/+8, 30-step touchMove trajectory to note-tile-t4 center (70,534), final touchMove @ (70,534), touchEnd.
4. Read IDB: total=6, Groceries=3, Errands=3, fresh uuidv4 note present in Errands, t1 unchanged, toast='Copied to "Errands" · Hold ⌘/Ctrl to move'.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation_if_product_wants_move: SortableTilesProvider.jsx L224 — detect touch input from event.activatorEvent (window.TouchEvent && orig instanceof TouchEvent, or orig.pointerType==='touch') and dispatch 'move' instead of 'copy'. Alternatively add app_settings.touch_drag_mode toggle and default it based on platform. NotesApp.jsx handleCrossPackMove already supports mode='move' via StorageService.moveNoteToCategory (L1890), so the frontend contract is ready.
